text_block_list.text: When I went to the shopping mall to buy groceries, I spotted Oguri Cap and the others standing in front of a shop.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible. I'd heard stories, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's surprisingly well-made, eh?
Wonder how much it cost to make~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. ...Actually,
they're selling Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's Tama, Creek... and even the President.
They're all quite adorable.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Oguri's the one sellin' the best.
Look, there's only one left before it's sold out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Not just in races, she's made a name for herself
in competitive eating contests too, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Old or young, guy or gal, she's wildly popular with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd want this Oguri too.
Unlike the real deal, she won't run up a food bill!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's got a face that looks real fast.
Trainer, why don't you try raisin' this one too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha, right on, eh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Oh shoot, that ain't good.
I was supposed to meet up with Inari.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out now, see ya!
Tamamo Cross hurried off.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll buy an Oguri Cap plushie.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wh-Why?
It's just a stuffed animal, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Um... even if I get a Trainer,
I'm still not running, you know?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No... I don't intend to stop you.
I see... so you're buying it."

Oguri Cap looks
rather downcast about something.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure you didn't want to buy it?
You wanted it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama's certainly right...
Stuffed animals don't cost anything for meals.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I pay for my own meals,
so I wouldn't be burdening my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, plushies are fluffy,
and they're small and cute. I can't compete with that.
choice_data_list: What's been the matter with you for a while now...?
What's been the matter with you for a while now...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I think the real thing would be better.
After all, I can run really fast."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A plushie may not be able to, but... I believe I
can live up to Trainer's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No... I will live up to your expectations.
Even more than a plushie could."
choice_data_list: The real thing is the best.
The real thing is the best.
Plushies are a way to show support.
Plushies are a way to show support, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No... I will live up to your expectations.
Even more than a plushie could."
choice_data_list: The real thing is the best.
The real thing is the best.
Plushies are a way to show support.
Plushies are a way to show support, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me. With you by my side, Trainer,
I can become stronger and faster than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will tackle this training with everything I have.
No matter how grueling it may be.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm much sturdier than a plushie, after all.
From now on, rely on me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... Fair point.
It's not something you can just nurture, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A form of support... Thinking about it that way
somehow makes power well up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The people who bought the plushies, and Trainer too...
they are all my source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I will keep running from here on out.
Leave it to me, Trainer.
